collections.title: Reference gardens
collections.description: Public-garden records with parcel geometry, mapping confidence, planning scope, and source lineage.

collections.title: Garden parcel boundaries
collections.description: Canonical tax-parcel and garden-property boundaries in OGC CRS84. These are the geographic containers for site, bed, and plant observations.

collections.title: Garden site context
collections.description: Canonical outdoor-space context including continuous paths and roads, buildings, parking, utilities, fences, water, garden sections, and vegetation cover.

collections.title: Garden beds and plots
collections.description: Canonical polygon footprints for beds, plots, and subplots, linked to their containing parcel and site hierarchy.

collections.title: Mapped garden plants
collections.description: Canonical point or multipoint plant observations and planning placements, linked to a bed when known and honest about taxonomic certainty.

collections.title: Flower planning references
collections.description: Curated condition and planning records derived from cited government, Extension, and open research sources.

collections.title: Public source registry
collections.description: Stable source identifiers, publishers, URLs, access notes, and the fields each source supports.

collections.title: Garden 3D model assets
collections.description: Redistributable GLB assets with creator, license, source, checksum, byte size, plant mappings, and representation limits.
